Earth's curvature concentrates solar energy at the equator.
Temperature decreases with increasing altitude at about 6.5°C per 1000 meters.
Higher altitude air is less dense and absorbs less terrestrial radiation.
Land absorbs and releases heat faster than water, so oceans moderate coastal climate.
